title: AudioEffectRecord fails in web build (single thread)
body:
### Tested versions

Godot v4.4.beta1 - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - AMD Ryzen 9 7950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads)

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta1 - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - AMD Ryzen 9 7950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads)

### Issue description

Possible duplicate:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/94037


AudioEffectRecord fails to record in Web build for single threaded exports.
(When thread_support is enabled, the issue goes away.)

Following the guide [here](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/tutorials/export/exporting_for_web.html#audio-playback), Stream vs. Sample does not seem to matter, as Line 204 still fails with an error:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/servers/audio/effects/audio_effect_record.cpp#L204C1-L205C1

```
tmp_js_export.js:474 ERROR: Condition "current_instance->recording_data.is_empty()" is true. Returning: nullptr
at: get_recording (servers/audio/effects/audio_effect_record.cpp:204)
```

And a bunch of other errors:

```
tmp_js_export.js:474 ERROR: OS::get_process_id() is not available on the Web platform.  at: get_process_id (platform/web/os_web.cpp:132)
```

```
tmp_js_export.js:9 The AudioContext was not allowed to start. It must be resumed (or created) after a user gesture on the page.
```

```
ERROR: U_FILE_ACCESS_ERROR  at: _spoof_check (modules/text_server_adv/text_server_adv.cpp:7144)
```

(If Sample is enabled:)
```
tmp_js_export.js:474 WARNING: /root/MicRecord/AudioStreamRecord is trying to play a sample from a stream that cannot be sampled.
```



### Steps to reproduce

(Godot Demo Project)
Run project
Build to Web
Try to record
Observe errors in web debugger

(Modified example from #94037)
Run project
Build to Web
Press the button in the middle to initialize the audio effect variable
Mouse click and release anywhere else to attempt to save the recording
Observe errors in web debugger


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Godot Demo Project
https://godotengine.org/asset-library/asset/2760

Or:

Modified example from #94037
